titre: Devoir de contrôle n°1 - Anglais (1ère année secondaire)

exercices.enonce:
TEXT
Nowadays, more and more young people dream of studying abroad. My cousin Sami is one of them. Last year, he won a scholarship to study engineering in France. At first, his parents were worried because he had never left the country. However, Sami was very determined. He worked hard to learn French and prepared all his documents carefully. Today, he lives in Paris and he is very happy with his choice. He says that studying abroad has taught him to be independent and open-minded. Of course, he sometimes misses his family and Tunisian food, but he calls his parents every weekend. Sami believes that this experience will help him build a bright future.

I. READING COMPREHENSION (8 marks)
1) What does Sami's cousin dream of, like many young people?   (2 marks)
2) Why were his parents worried at first?   (2 marks)
3) What has studying abroad taught Sami?   (2 marks)
4) What does Sami sometimes miss?   (2 marks)

II. LANGUAGE (6 marks)
1) Put the verb in the correct tense: Last year, he (win) ______ a scholarship.   (1,5 marks)
2) Complete with the present perfect: Studying abroad ______ (teach) him to be independent.   (1,5 marks)
3) Complete with the right linker (however / because / so): His parents were worried ______ he had never left the country.   (1,5 marks)
4) Give the opposite of "happy" = ______.   (1,5 marks)

III. WRITING (6 marks)
Would you like to study or travel abroad? Write a paragraph (about 8-10 lines) explaining your opinion, with reasons and examples. Use linkers.
